api_generation: Microsoft Foundry Projects 2.x with project-scoped OpenAI Evals; recorded-output JSONL data source
package_status: Selected released, non-beta packages. This is a compatible pinned set, not a claim that these are the latest releases.

sources.purpose: Exact Projects API pattern and inline source types
Groundedness mapping and deployment_name initialization parameter
Projects dependency constraints and release notes
Exact OpenAI per-item shape: datasource_item, results, passed and score
Exact OpenAI run counts, criterion counts and async status shape
Exact OpenAI pagination and output-item pass/fail status filter
Current evaluation-only prerequisites and client setup
Current asynchronous completion, cancellation, results and pagination guidance

limitations: Latest release metadata exposed Projects 2.11.0/OpenAI 3.50.0, but that package set could not be installed from this environment's package mirror and public wheel endpoint. It was not validated or selected.
The current Learn introduction recommends Projects >=2.2.0. The chosen set satisfies that generation boundary; upgrade deliberately and repeat smoke/live integration checks.
The release-tagged generic sample uses model for some initialization parameters; the groundedness-specific sample uses deployment_name. This adapter follows the groundedness-specific reference.
Release samples omit canceled termination and bounded polling and sometimes delete evaluations. This implementation deliberately does not copy those behaviors.

Groundedness availability, permissions, judge deployment, regional support, service output shape and real score calibration still require a live integration check. No capability inherits a blanket GA or preview claim from package status.
